name: P6_DEFERRED_LEXICOGRAPHIC
coverage: own admitted canonical endpoint pair bins from frozen non-GT local odometry arc length /50m
tie_break: class, optional direction attempts/arrivals, transfer, original rank, descending confidence, discovery event, canonical IDs
eligibility: finite original SC candidates, both endpoints arrived; sequential original ranks only; no GT/quality gate
D0_D1: same non-weighted eligibility and FIFO order; D0 drops at event end, D1 queues
D2: same as D1 plus explicit bridge/coverage/cached lexicographic priority
D3: same as D2 plus least-served direction attempts/arrivals within a priority class; not a weighted score
P5_comparison_caveat: D1 versus P5 changes weighted eligibility too; D0 isolates queue benefit within P6 family
duplicate_rule: drop a new query whose current canonical identity is already pending; after resolution allow fresh original receipt attempts, suppress graph neighborhoods exactly delta3/delta5
rank_dependency: only rank1 initially; after measured failure unlock next original rank; any geometric success closes query even if graph-duplicate; expiration/invalid/drop closes remaining ranks
unknown_rule: commit selection before receipt access; missing receipt halts that policy at first unresolved decision, never continue with guessed state
budget: same frozen cumulative calls and application bytes, last100 call/byte caps, fixed full-stream publication reserved;249 bytes reserved pre-attempt; released if not graph-admitted
CPU_cap: historical hard compute unit is calls; additional predicted-ms caps = call caps * max frozen predicted per-call ms, identical for all P6 variants and redundant, NOT a new physical CPU-time guarantee
queue_parameters: engineering hypotheses frozen before running, not GT tuned
